$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKJ (AIP France, chart dated 2026-01-22): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Ajaccio Napoléon Bonaparte

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

service.atsHours: H 24 - AD AJACCIO NAPOLEON BONAPARTE BP 70979 - 20700 Ajaccio CEDEX 9 (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : -1HR)

notes: (1) MAX thrust offset for B747, B757 and B763: reduction 92 m.
Non home-based ULM: Use of AD only with agreement from apron control (PCE) and ATS services.
Contact: pce1@cci.corsica (or 04 95 23 56 19) and temps-reel.ajaccio@aviation-civile.gouv.fr PPR 48 HR.
Important bird presence (AD and vicinity).
High voltage line R 020/1,3 NM DTHR 20, peak altitude 211 ft AMSL, height up to 130 ft AGL, only pylons are lighted at night.
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.
In the CTR, regular activity of air photography with a drone.
MAX height: 500 ft ASFC.
To safeguard property and people, some summer day, heavy seaplane activity in phase of bailing in the vicinity of the aerodrome in Porticcio bay and in Ajaccio harbour.
Paraglider activity in the vicinity of CTR on an axis crossing N, NZ and NV.
Towed paragliding activity from a boat, with a non-visible nylon cable approximately 450 m long, up to a MAX height of 1000 ft in "Golfe de Sagone", Liscia bay.
Special caution recommended.
Landing lights compulsory in CTR manage their flight in order to reach or cross NW at 2000 ft AMSL.
TRANSITS W <---> SA: Unless opposite clearance, recommended altitude 2000 ft AMSL MAX: Route W --> SA: Preferential ALT 2000 AMSL; Route SA --> W: Preferential ALT 1500 AMSL.
TRANSITS N <---> SC <---> SEA: Unless opposite clearance, recommended FL above FL 055: Route N --> SEA: Preferential FL 075; Route SEA --> N: Preferential FL 065 500 ft AMSL.
Training flight authorized only with an instructor pilot.
Downwind leg east of RWY.
RWY 20, use as aiming point the touchdown marking and not the.
DTHR marking.
TWY H: MAX wingspan 24 m day time use only.
TWY F: only for Civil safety ACFT and towed ACFT with a MAX wingspan of 36 m.
TWY A/C/D/D1/D2/E/G1/G2: MAX wingspan 36 m TWY B: MAX wingspan 65 m.
TWY T: MAX wingspan 36 m.
In presence of IFR ACFT in the CTR: VIS 3000 m - ceiling 1000 ft AAL.
RESTRICTIONS: LDG RWY 20 prohibited.
Activity prohibited if hazard light of Monte Sant' Angelo is not available.
Local flights are limited to only 1 ACFT maximum.
AERODROME CIRCUITS: West of RWY 02/20, ALT 1500 AMSL.
HELICOPTERS: FATO not usable at night; mandatory use of RWY to land and take-off.; Minima VFRs by night: VIS 4000m and ceiling 1000ft.
AAL for helicopters on route SB-SA and WA-W without presence of IFR ACFT within CTR or other VFRs helicopter (possible holding).
PROCEDURE: TKOF 02 and aborted LDG RWY 02: climb runway heading up to 1000 ft AMSL MNM at the latest 2 NM after DTHR RWY 20, then turn left still climbing.
Possible in flight waiting patterns at SA and W between 3000 ft and 5000 ft to avoid interference with IFR flight.
FLIGHT IN THE CTR: Weather conditions: height of cloud base greater than or equal to 3500 ft AAL.; VIS greater than or equal to 5 km; Minimum altitude: 3000 ft AMSL.
OTHER FLIGHTS: Routes of arrival and departure are: Northbound WA <---> W <---> NW Southbound SB <---> SA <---> S Minimum altitude: 3000 ft AMSL.
VIS greater than or equal to 5 km below FL100.
On pilot's request and after clearance, the pilot in charge of the obstacle clearance can disregard the following of these routes.
In maritime crossing, the compulsory route for arrival / departure is: NW <---> W.
Delay to expect if IFR traffic in the CTR.
Traffic surveillance equipment: AD equipped with secondary surveillance radar (see AD 1.0) and ADS-B.
Aerobatics (NR 7000): axis RWY 02/20 centered on AD ARP; 3000 AMSL / 5000 AMSL; SR-SS with AJACCIO TWR authorization.
Activity prohibited on SAT, SUN and HOL from May 1st to September 30th.
Meteo conditions: Visi > 5 km - Ceiling > 5000 ft.
AEM (NR 9621): 300 AAL; activity authorized according to the draft agreement with the associations.
Users' information on ATIS or ATC FREQ.
Radiocommunication failure: If possible, use GSM to call TWR: (+33)4 95 23 59 60 Before having received the clearance to enter in D airspace: do not enter.
After receiving the clearance to enter the CTR: follow the last clearance, do not interfere with RWY 02/20, follow optical instructions.
Try to call TWR Chief: 04 95 20 11 95 (emergency number only).
Prior TKOF: cancel departure.
Return to PRKG.
After TKOF: turn and go back.
Join downwind of RWY in use, do not interfere with RWY 02/20, follow optical instructions.
